$about: Ambient fireflies. Data only — no functions, no asset paths. Unknown keys are ignored; invalid values fall back to the defaults in config.ts and are reported in the console.
$placement: areaSize is the full [x, y, z] extent of the volume, centred on the effect's own origin — position fireflies.object3d to put that centre where you want it. clearRadius hollows out the middle so the play area stays free.
$look: Sizes are world units. minScreenSize is a floor in screen space (fraction of viewport height) that keeps the far ones from going sub-pixel. Keep glowIntensity near 1: the halos merge into haze above ~1.5.
$motion: Speeds are world units per second and set how fast a firefly reads, not how far it strays — that follows from areaSize. pulseAmount is the depth of the blink; 1 goes fully dark at the bottom of the cycle.
